_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from U.S. Treasury sanctions, UK National Crime Agency releases, UK court reporting by RTÉ, and RTÉ Nuacht. Status reflects the latest cited action per person; sanctions, charges, and convictions are distinct. Country associations describe historical source-backed activity, not current locations. Public named figures only; no operational routes, enforcement gaps, precise positions, or photos without verified reuse rights.

sources.title: Treasury Sanctions Notorious Kinahan Organized Crime Group
sources.claim: Treasury designated the group in April 2022 and stated it operated in Ireland and was established in the United Kingdom, Spain and United Arab Emirates; these are historical country-level associations.

sources.title: UK head of Kinahan crime group jailed for 21 years
sources.claim: NCA describes the group’s UK arm and identifies Thomas Kavanagh as its UK figurehead.

people.name: Christopher Vincent Kinahan Senior
people.roleLabel: Founder; historical drug and money-laundering prison sentences; sanctioned in 2022

evidence.claim: The Irish Times reports Kinahan Senior was imprisoned in Ireland for dealing heroin; the country marker refers to that historical drug conduct, not nationality or current location.
